notes.title: September Development Update
notes.content:
[p]Hey folks, we're here to give you an update on the new things coming to Mirthwood as we draw closer to the end of the year. As always, thank you for your feedback! We monitor all of it as we continue to work on building & improving Mirthwood.[/p][p][/p][p]We've released a small update today with performance and early game improvements:[/p][list][*][p][i]Performance optimizations[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Updated early quests for smoother onboarding[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Balance adjustments to reduce early game grind[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Increased amount of seeds available for purchase from seeds vendor[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Lowered cost of farm animals[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Add lower cost (and slower) mount[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]You can now expand available tool slots (inventory)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]New HUD notifications for important info (e.g. low hunger, weak tool, etc.)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/e45b24a5a53d646f9827bf59be6d7e9a99ca87c4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]What's up next?[/h1][p]We're hard at work on some larger Mirthwood updates, which we plan to bring before the calendar turns to 2026 [i](...!)[/i]. The dates here are subject to change (cuz game dev), but this is the target. We'll have more details and previews as we inch closer to each of these updates.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]1. Steam Deck Verification[b] [/b][i](September-October)[/i][/h3][p]Steam Deck Verification is just around the corner. We're making a few final tweaks based on Valve’s feedback (mostly minor scaling adjustments). That said... we’ve already put [i]a lot[/i] of work into optimization of late, and the game runs well on Deck even now. So if you’re eager to dive in, go for it! Otherwise, the official Verified badge shouldn’t be far off.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/3f3678f2e5a5e2235749252383677694cdc9a4eb.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]2. Foundations Update[/b] [i](late October)[/i][/h3][p]The foundations update will bring new features and content ranging from Festivals, to Random Encounters, to larger World Events. These additions will help to breathe new life into the world, and introduce life & death consequences to its denizens:[/p][list][*][p][i]New World Events[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]New Seasonal Festivals[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]NPC Death (and replacement...)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Random Events & Encounters[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Pets![/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/80c7c76218b30816c97828eddb3158eab16ffa19.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]3. Online Multiplayer [i](November)[/i][/h3][p]Online multiplayer development for Mirthwood is coming along well, and we expect it to be ready for release before the end of the year.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]4. Seafarers Expansion[/b] [i](December)[/i][/h3][p]Take to the sea and search for your family in a new story expansion, featuring new characters, quests, gameplay mechanics, cosmetics, and more:[/p][list][*][p][i]Build up your customizable ship[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Recruit a rag-tag crew[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Brave the Sea and engage in different sailing activates[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Make your way to new islands as you uncover the fate of your family[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Grimrock awakens[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/3303a5f377f58646947a673d743e3be2fb43ff2e.png"][/img][/p][h3]Additions to Date[/h3][p]If you're new to Mirthwood and curious about what's changed since launch, here’s a snapshot of what's been added over the past few months:[/p][list][*][p][i]Marriage & Children[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Generated Quests[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Reworked NPC Skills & NPC Hiring[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Local Co-Op[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Yuletide & Night of the Falling Stars Content[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Optimizations to performance & combat[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Steam Deck improvements (optimization, controls, scaling)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]
We've also returned the [b]demo[/b], so you can check that out if you're interested. If you enjoy the game, you'll be able to continue seamlessly from your demo save.[/p]

notes.title: Dev Update: May 2025
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Just wanted to check in and share what we’ve been working on.

Since the marriage update, our focus has been on bringing [b]co-op[/b] functionality to Mirthwood. This is coming along nicely! When we get a bit closer we’ll share more details - but expect to play together remotely (through Steam remote play) or locally, while each managing your own inventories and skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/74ec76d83c51575ff9ca5ab9ca37a4ddcfbe6ec3.png[/img]
We’re also going to be working (with a partner) on [b]porting to the Switch[/b], which we’re excited about! However, this has required updating our Unity version, which is unexpectedly eating into some of the development time set aside for other roadmap items.

Beyond this, we’re continuing to work on additional content like children, instruments, and… something larger. But more on that later!

Thanks to all of you who have played, commented, and critiqued. We appreciate you all!

notes.title: Marriage Update is Here!
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We're happy to announce a large update today centered around the addition of Marriage to Mirthwood. Without further ado, let's jump into what's in this update.


[h1]Marriage[/h1]
You can now propose to any romanceable NPC in Mirthwood. Should your proposal be accepted, your spouse will move to the farm after a humble wedding ceremony.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/3e3003923314a110751b5ad72e0e5863d70af467.png[/img]


We've reworked NPC Skills with this update, so you may want to make sure you and your significant other are compatible long-term. Your spouse's [i]Skills[/i] will determine the type of items they'll collect ( ...or destroy), while their overall happiness can affect their productivity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/ef47a084c55eda3f35cbcf7c9e0c3858052a0694.png[/img]

Your spouse will help out on the farm, and even give [i]you[/i] tasks from time to time. Their are several "Spouse Types", which essentially determine your spouse's love language; some may prefer gifts, some conversation, while others may prefer acts of service. 

If ignored for too long... their productivity won't be the only thing to leave.


[h1]Hired Hands[/h1]
You are now be able to [b]hire NPCs[/b] to perform a number of different jobs - whether you need some help on the farm, or someone to brave the mines in search of ore. 

Learning what characters are skilled at will help you get the best results. Plus, if you're on good terms, they'll be more inclined to lower their price.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/def52f827eab0b8a3e295efd2444f9a0c3bd26e8.png[/img]



[h1]Layered Armor[/h1]
We've added some new armor types: Cuirasses and Greaves. These plate armors can be equipped over your shirts and pants, giving much greater visual customization for you character and a wider variety armor to craft at your anvil.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/d1db79b836971364be9933f92ab02e832eeed448.png[/img]


[h1]Generated Quests[/h1]
In addition to reworked Skills and Hiring, NPCs will now have occasional radiant quests for players. They'll ask for your help with different tasks: [b]Hunting, gathering, bounties, deliveries, acquiring medicine, and more[/b]. Help them out or leave them hanging, the choice is yours.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/01e5e221ce3b200cad9c6950aa4eedda85534e24.png[/img]


[h1]What else?[/h1]
There's still a bit more in this update. We've greatly expanded the types of [b]fish[/b] that can be caught, added upgraded [b]fishing rods[/b], new [b]recipes[/b], [b]diagrams[/b], [b]loot[/b], and a [b]Craftsman's Table[/b] to get to work on some new home goods. We added new [b]Social tab[/b] to help keep track of relationships and hired hands, and you can now [b]track NPCs on the map[/b].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/4ae0b1bea249756d61a98d11547e7d81461ba19b.png[/img]


We hope you enjoy the update and, as always, let us know what you think. The best place to do so is in our [url=https://discord.gg/h6UymAvQaj]wonderful Discord community.[/url] You can check out the full patch notes below.

In the meantime, we're getting right back to work on more for Mirthwood.



[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Relationships & NPCs[/h3]
- Reworked NPC/Spouse skill functions
- New “Social” tab to help keep track of relationships
- Player can now track NPCs on the map
- Players can now give Gifts to NPCs
- NPCs can now be Hired to perform different jobs
- NPCs will best perform tasks suited to their Skills
- Unlock Skills/Traits through chat, gifts, and quests
[h3]Marriage[/h3]
- Players can now marry an NPC
- Spouses will move to the farm and help with tasks
- Spouses will gather (or lose) materials based on their skills
- Spouses will give the player occasional tasks
- Spouses can become unhappy and leave if ignored
- Spouse happiness can affect productivity
[h3]Generated Quests[/h3]
- NPCs will now offer the Player radiant quests
- Completing (or ignoring) accepted quests will affect relationship levels
- Spouses will give the Player occasional tasks
[h3]Layered Armor[/h3]
- You can now equip plate armor on top of shirts, dresses, brigandines, etc.
- You can now equip greaves on top of pants
- New armor & diagrams can be found at blacksmiths or through exploration
[h3]New Items[/h3]
- New craftable fishing rods to make fishing more manageable
- More than doubled the number of fish types to catch
- New recipes & meals
- New Craftsman’s Table for crafting furniture
- New armor types
[h3]Other[/h3]
- Add ranged enemy type
- Refreshed pause/settings menu UI
- Various balance adjustments
- Fast Travel locked until gathering a Binding Stone

notes.title: Mirthwood finally adds marriage in huge, smooch-filled update, and it's on sale
notes.content:
Stardew Valley truly pioneered the cozy game genre. It has everything from crafting to farming, and from dynamic villager relations to fully-rounded romance. As a result, it feels like every life game has to have those exact same elements - realistically, we all just want to smooch our favorite villagers. Mirthwood, a farming sim that transports Stardew's traditional mechanics into a hand-drawn, Fable-esque world, has sadly been lacking in the marriage department, but not anymore. Rejoice, my hopeless romantics: Mirthwood is finally letting you tie the knot, and it's currently available at a discount.

notes.title: Night of Falling Stars Patch Notes, Winter Sale Discount, and our Dev Roadmap!

Since launch, we've been hard at work making improvement and content patches to Mirthwood. Our goal, is to continue these patches all through next year and hopefully beyond. We've heard and processed community feedback and we've made changes and implemented new features to the game based on that feedback. If you haven't already, we invite you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/RACfdPMC9e]Mirthwood discord[/url]. notes.title: Patch 1.0.30p2 - Combat Changes
notes.content:
Hello folks,

Just dropping by to provide a brief update on some changes we've made to combat. The changes are mainly centered around the usage of stamina/energy during combat, or when sprinting or dodging.

[b][i]Stamina is based on your current Energy, and is drained when sprinting or performing combat actions. After a short delay, it starts to regenerate. You will also now face the mouse when in combat and attack in the mouse/stick direction instead of facing the closest enemy. Enemies also move slightly faster when trying to get in attack range.[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/b391abe152556cfd9ce46ccab4f068d2178037c9.gif[/img]

The goal here is to prevent the easy spamming of attacks that removes all thought/effort from combat, while also making managing your energy level more important before engaging in fights.

[b]If you're not into these changes, don't worry![/b] They do make combat more challenging, but you can easily turn them off in settings.

While we have much more planned, this is a first step toward improving the combat experience in Mirthwood - and of course - we always have an ear out for your feedback.

Once more, we recommend [url=https://discord.gg/h6UymAvQaj]joining the Discord[/url]! It's the best place to get a peek at upcoming content, provide feedback, submit bugs, and just hang out with the community.

[h2][b]Patch 1.0.30p2:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Improve combat facing/attack direction with gamepad
[*] Use stamina when sprinting or performing combat actions
      # Don't regen stamina while aiming the bow
      # Don't use stamina to sprint while mounted
      # Allow actions when at max energy (for low max energy)
      # Only use stamina for blocking when an attack is blocked
[*] Easy Combat setting disables stamina system
[*] Face the mouse when in combat
[*] Player attacks in mouse/stick direction
[*] Remove combat lock on
[*] Bow face direction only with right stick when aiming (fix issues of capped aim direction with left stick)
[*] Bow movement speed while aiming reduced from 50% to 40% (players is slower)
[*] Enemies move slightly faster to get in attack range
[*] Hide mouse cursor when using a gamepad
[*] Default Sprint key to Ctrl
[*] Fix key prompts for shift/ctrl/alt
[*] Added Switch controller support
[*] Added more inputs to Controls settings (Move, Call Mount, Interacts, Walk Toggle)
[*] Add ability to place multiple map markers
[*] Fix rain fog effects from ground clipping
[*] Decrease farm animal volume, frequency
[*] Fixed issue causing boulders/logs to respawn on farm
[*] Resource/enemy spawners throttle when loading for smoother area loading
[*] Fix credits not showing

notes.title: Thank You for Your Support!
notes.content:
Hello Mirthwood community!

First, we want to extend a huge thank you to each and every one of you for joining our small team on this journey. Watching Mirthwood come to life in the hands of players has been an incredibly humbling experience. The feedback, suggestions, and support we've received have been invaluable to us as we continue to develop the game. As a small, two-person team, every bit of feedback is not only appreciated— it’s essential to helping us make Mirthwood the best it can be.


[h2]Actively Working on Improvements[/h2]

We know that some players have run into issues along the way, and we're hard at work on bug fixes and performance improvements to ensure everyone has a smooth experience. With each update, we aim to address the most critical issues and refine the overall gameplay experience. We're listening to your feedback daily, and our goal is to continue evolving Mirthwood in a way that respects your time and support.


[h2]Updated Regional Pricing[/h2]

We’ve also made some updates to regional pricing to better align with the diverse regions of our player base. We want to make Mirthwood accessible to as many players as possible, and we hope these adjustments reflect that commitment.


[h2]Join Our Discord Community![/h2]

If you’re interested in following the development even more closely, or if you’d like to share your thoughts and connect directly with us, [url=https://discord.gg/h6UymAvQaj][b]please consider joining our Discord community[/b][/url]. It’s a great place to meet fellow adventurers, share ideas, and chat directly with us about Mirthwood. Your feedback there helps shape the game, and we’re grateful for every voice that’s part of the conversation.

Thank you again for your incredible support. We’re excited to keep building Mirthwood with you, and we look forward to seeing you in-game and on Discord!

notes.title: Launch Day!
notes.content:
[h1]The Journey Has Just Begun.[/h1]

Hello Folks!

We’re thrilled to announce that Mirthwood is officially out now and ready for you to play! After months of hard work and invaluable feedback from you all, we’re so excited to finally share this magical journey with you. Your support for our small team, patience, and input have been crucial in making this game what it is today, and we couldn’t have done it without you.

[previewyoutube=NoQ_Mnuv2FE;full][/previewyoutube]

We want to take a moment to express our heartfelt thanks to everyone who’s been with us every step of the way. Whether you joined us during the early days of development, participated in our closed beta events, or have been following along from the sidelines, your support has meant the world to us.

A huge thank you to everyone who participated in our closed beta in September and October. Your feedback helped us fine-tune the game and ensure a smooth launch. If you haven’t already, be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/h6UymAvQaj]join our growing Discord community[/url] to stay updated on future developments and connect with fellow players.

We have set up a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2272900/discussions/0/4626979420667667615/]known issues and bug reporting thread[/url] in the Steam discussions, please feel free to report something if you experience any issues and we’ll work on fixes as quickly as we can.

We also have great news for [b]Steam Deck[/b] players, we have added Steam Deck support and full controller support, so if you are playing on Steam Deck, please let us know how you are enjoying the game. We achieved a good experience with the following settings:

Medium Settings
No Shadows
Full Screen Checked
V-Sync Checked
FPS capped at 60hz

While today marks the official release, this is just the beginning. 

We’re planning future updates, including new content, events, optimizations, modding support, extended language support, and more. 

We’ll spend time over the next few weeks working on any issues that arise during the launch and then share what the next big thing coming to the world of Mirthwood will be! 

We’re committed to making [i]Mirthwood[/i] even better with every update, and we can’t wait to hear what you think as you begin your adventure. So send any requests and ideas on future features you would like to see!

Here’s to many more magical moments ahead!

Warmly,


Daron & Brian

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hello Folks!

We’re excited to share some important updates with you regarding the progress of Mirthwood.

As many of you know, we initially postponed our launch from September 11, 2024, to November 6, 2024. This decision was made to ensure that the game is as optimized and polished as possible before it reaches your PCs.

Today, we're pleased to confirm that we are on track for the November 6 release. Barring any unforeseen circumstances, Mirthwood will be available for purchase and download on the scheduled date.

Our focus for the launch is to integrate several key elements from our previously released roadmap into the day-one version of the game. We're working tirelessly to include everything we’ve planned right from the start. Additionally, game optimization remains a top priority, with the goal of ensuring Mirthwood runs smoothly on the Steam Deck! We’re also working hard to provide localization in multiple languages, and we’ll share more updates as we get closer to the official release.

On the weekend of September 21, we hosted a closed beta event, announced via our Discord. Nearly 700 players participated, and their feedback has been invaluable to Mirthwood’s development. We are incredibly grateful to everyone who took part—your input has been instrumental.

If you haven’t already, [url=https://discord.gg/h6UymAvQaj]we warmly invite you to join our growing Discord community[/url]. Since September, the Mirthwood Discord has grown significantly, and it’s the best place to stay informed about our development progress. It’s also the only way to sign up for our next closed beta, which is planned for mid-to-late October.

The support we’ve received from this community has been nothing short of remarkable and truly humbling. We firmly believe that our decision to delay was the right one, and we can’t wait for Mirthwood to charm and captivate you when it launches. Thank you again for your continued support, and we look forward to seeing you soon!

Warm regards,

Daron & Brian

notes.title: Post Launch + Multiplayer + Localization Updates
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Daron from Bad Ridge Games here. As we near the launch of the game, we are excited to share some of our plans for it in the months ahead. As always, we welcome your feedback!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/c68a369ac565d23ff10f762bb1994f1440b1b712.png[/img]
[h2]Co-op Multiplayer[/h2]

Mirthwood was always designed as a single-player experience. That said, we have heard you. Many of you have requested co-op, and so that is something that we will be working on after the launch. We are aiming for two-player co-op functionality, both local and online. We don’t have a timeline yet. As a two-man team, we need to focus on the launch and, of course, fix any bugs that crop up in your adventures first.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/720ca2ddc8839d23a6f241003938cd22ecad10a4.png[/img]
[h2]Modding Support For PC[/h2]

After launch, we will add PC modding support and aim to work with modders to provide them with the tools and support needed to create fun new experiences for us all.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/3e83dc08fe187ceaa3b199606b9f05ed28860dc4.png[/img]
[h2]The Family Update[/h2]

A free content update will be available after the launch. It will introduce heartwarming family dynamics, enabling players to nurture and grow their in-game families, including having children. We’ll share more with you as we get closer to this update's release.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/09ba7a1603a976fce303c517d531986ec5d012ef.png[/img]
[h2]Festivities And Seasonal Content[/h2]

Those who have played the demo may have seen that we teased the jousting festival. After the launch, we plan on adding an array of festivals to the game over time, which will be limited-time events in the game world that appear occasionally. We will also be doing seasonal content from time to time for things like Halloween, which may contain additional items or quests. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/cd7e6274f24c5c02699162f0c52581098a9a45fa.png[/img]
[h2]DLC And More Free Content[/h2]

We plan to support Mirthwood post-launch with additional free content updates and paid DLC expansions. We will share more about these sometime in 2025, but we are incredibly excited to support the game over the long haul. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/e9d790f0a01825a724204bbfc69fc976a11619b2.png[/img]

Localization for multiple languages is being worked on, and we are trying to complete it as soon as possible. However, as we are a two-man team, we are currently unsure if it will be fully implemented for the launch day. If we cannot finish it by the launch day, we will roll out localization in the days after the launch. Our priority is ensuring the game is finished and fixing as many bugs and performance issues as possible for the launch. Please be patient with our small team as we try to get everything done :) 

Many of you have been asking about the game price and Steamdeck support. We are working on getting the Steam deck verified and can now confirm that the game price will be $24.99 or your regional equivalent. 

We are both incredibly excited and nervous to have you all enter the world of Mirthwood. We are incredibly thankful for all the support and love you have given us and hope you enjoy your adventures.

notes.title: A Simulated World
notes.content:
Hi Folks, Daron here from Bad Ridge Games. Today, we’re taking a look at how the world around you functions in Mirthwood. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/deb613dd28ea7e317f7211abb336dc1d0de6c799.png[/img]


[h2]Seasons of Change[/h2]
In Mirthwood, you will experience the distinct beauty and challenges of the seasons  - Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter - with each bringing its own crops, colors, and events. With Mirthwood being an open-world, this has been no small task. The game features seven large main regions, each with unique aesthetics and sub-biomes. This means each change of season offers a myriad of new visuals depending on where you travel.

Transitioning into Winter will have the most impact on gameplay. With no crops to be grown, you’ll need to shift your focus to other tasks like mining, upgrades, or other adventures. For the inhabitants of the world, potential shortages of food can be deadly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/972afa0849678118539908a6f8c6340f977bd46e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/634cae555a13062644d08f5066a1ad0993b7f7eb.jpg[/img]



[h2]Raising the Stakes[/h2]
Most NPCs in Mirthwood are mortal and can pass away, whether from starvation, illness, or if they find themselves the victim of a bandit or animal attack.

This gives NPCs real and tangible goals to work towards. Mortality also paves the way for organic stories to develop. Characters that die will be known to you, possibly even close friends. While there may be opportunities for you to intervene, not every life can be saved. Those who die are buried, and in time, replaced by a new immigrant from the Continent.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/54daded8c8f6e7e7425d6ea80f1d98defb10e2aa.png[/img]

[h2]The Storyteller[/h2]
Mirthwood’s storyteller will generate [i]Events[/i] of varying intensity to keep things interesting. Some Events are seasonal - you might encounter a [i]Heatwave[/i] in Summer or a [i]Blizzard[/i] in Winter. Other Events can happen year round, like a [i]Full Moon[/i] (...enjoy). Not all Events present challenges. You’ll be notified if a [i]Traveling Merchant[/i] is nearby, or if the [i]Trade Ship[/i] has arrived and docked at the coast, bringing rare items from the Continent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/d54f952a99cc949533905cf9378bcef62d034a6a.png[/img]



[h2]Survival & Crafting[/h2]
Mirthwood will feature survival-lite gameplay. You’ll need to pay attention to your core vitals - [b]Health[/b], [b]Stamina[/b], and [b]Hunger[/b]. If you decide to set out and travel across the map, be sure to have a plan for food. Many herbs and berries can be foraged, but cooked meals offer the most benefit. Herbs will also help you craft elixirs and medicines vital to curing illnesses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/74237c65c160bdbf9debbc0c63a4296508aac4d4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/c4f5b7a68eacbccf12110d220858367968e9c2c7.png[/img]

You’ll discover [b]campsites[/b] and [b]settlements[/b] across the map that serve as respites, places to cook, sleep, and save your progress. Some of these campsites can be upgraded and turned into strategic homes-away-from-home for your character. Here you'll be able to access your stash, cook, and craft gear provided you have the materials.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/8ddc44c456b22836a8f4fa808ee99422c766e3a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/0bd0735f9760013b508831cf7c68ed7b01bd18d2.png[/img]


Hopefully that gives you some insight into world experience in Mirthwood. Let us know what questions you have!

notes.title: Character Customization
notes.content:
[h2]Foundations[/h2]
During the opening chapter of Mirthwood, you'll create your own character. Here, you will get a chance to create a unique backstory and customize your appearance, choosing between different body types, skin tones, eye, brow, hair and beard styles.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/1fe61ca33a7ced34140c568972d289ed48b7f9f1.png[/img]


[h2]Dress for Success[/h2]
The manner in which you dress can affect the way different social classes or individuals view you. Posh clothing will attract members of the Nobility, while unassuming, workman-like gear will fit in with the Peasant class. As a supplement to your character's leveled skills, apparel can serve a purpose beyond mere looks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/db74afd335212059fcb318f3e2c994fa52b87e2c.png[/img]


[h2]Equipping Your Character[/h2]
Your character will have 5 slots for gear: Head, Torso, Legs, Weapon, and Trinket. You can mix and match gear in these slots to your preference. Most are self-explanatory, but trinkets represent a type of wild card slot, allowing you to equip a variety of items with diverse affects. From a [i]Rabbit's Foot[/i] to a rare [i]Ruby Ring[/i], this slot will give you some flexibility on top of your standard gear. Let's take a look at the anatomy of an item:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/cb3d431c883a869c947af332755f3110a756b94d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/6c493015c2523bd375a4472e94b41b79745237a6.png[/img]


[h3]Item Preview[/h3]
Each item in Mirthwood features its own card. Cards are color coded according to rarity, featuring flavor text and hand-painted art that matches the in game item.

[h3]Stats[/h3]
All equipable items will have gold value and an armor or damage value. Crops, food, and other items will have different stats related to hunger, energy, and/or health.

[h3]Affiliations & Traits[/h3]
This is where gear gets a bit more fun. [b]Affiliations[/b] will attract different factions or groups to you - whether it be Royalty, Nobility, Peasanty, Criminals and more. [b]Traits[/b] often provide a stat buff, but can also help you perform actions more effectively, like playing an instrument.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/5d51cf71ee9269318c2ddcb9154cebb10f80420c.png[/img]

[h2]Your Character Card[/h2]
You'll be able to see changes to your character on your [i]character card[/i]. View your equipped gear, current stats, and your character's [i]"title"[/i], which directly reflects your standing in the world. Your [b]Morality[/b] and [b]Renown[/b] will shift based on your actions throughout the game. Completing quests and other activities will raise your [i]Renown,[/i] while making difficult choices, stealing, or killing can impact your [i]Morality[/i].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/1212502b0605d2bdf27229dc6acceba257fe6cce.png[/img]

We're currently adding a wealth of new gear to the game, including outfits, weapons, trinkets, and more. What medieval stylings would you like to see? Share your suggestions in the comments! 

And thanks for reading, you've gained 10 Renown!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/6f33d8feeca5e641416a4a54879ee634f91fc759.png[/img]

notes.title: Farming in Mirthwood
notes.content:
Hi Folks, Daron here from Bad Ridge Games. Today, we want to talk a bit about what to expect from the farming side of Mirthwood. 

Your homestead is your haven; a place of respite after your sojourns in the wider world. While there will be other, scattered locations for rest and (minor) customization, your home can serve as a portrait of your progress and productivity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/26bc94ed3663a42c1de8cf4fae3038f885446a0d.png[/img]

[h3]Crops[/h3]
We’ll start with the cornerstone of sustainable farming. You can grow more than 15 different crops, including wheat, barley, flax, and other medieval staples. Changing seasons will dictate the types of crops that will grow, keeping things fresh as the calendar turns. Your harvested crops can be used in cooking or placed in refiners to create more exciting goods. Be wary, you might encounter droughts, dust storms, and other hardships you’ll need to contend with.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/b78d385665c7a1f63954babd2d0c023121e08ec7.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/2d513d5603f73fca77e74dc6909b6eaea950ec3a.png[/img]

[h3]Refiners[/h3]
Refiners are the lifeblood of a productive farm. Here, you can take your raw resources and turn them into a variety of artisan goods. These goods can be given as gifts or used in other crafting recipes. You might take your harvested grapes and ferment them. Make some wine with those fermented grapes, or take things a step further and place that wine in a cask, creating a richly aged wine or brandy. With more than 10 different refiners to use, you’ll be able to craft a wide variety of items.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/c86d1786b773c893002e6f322c9f129b14e98352.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/72f2b8c5c3b0071d3f9634c95dd96a4b27b06c3a.png[/img]

[h3]Animals[/h3]
Farm animals in Mirthwood come in a variety of breeds and coats. Purchase and raise cows, bulls, goats, pigs, chickens, horses, and birds. In order to produce, your animals will need to be taken care of. There are multiple options for shelter and feed, giving you some flexibility in the housing of your animals and the layout of your farm. Goods from your animals can also be used in refiners. You can butcher your animals if you're in a pinch - or after some rarer meats.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/f7662209aa1bbdc140182e534c8deffd2ad7c0fd.png[/img]


[h3]Structures[/h3]
You can build several types of structures on your farm. Many of these will house your animals, while others will supplement your productivity; helping you mill grains or draw water.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/6f08a2ff7421c26bbdb67d2ec6e08d7a9471680e.png[/img]

[h3]Customization[/h3]
One of our favorite features in Mirthwood is the grid-less placement and pathing system. This will allow you to build up and layout your farm organically; creating curved paths and fence lines with ease. Inside your home, you can place items freely on walls and floors. There are a variety of themed decor goods for you to purchase in town. You’ll also be able to change the materials used inside or outside of your home.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/2ab2231485ba6a551408800bd2ba33356f6954ca.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/7e1c0fd57a4eef280a68bf81c57f9df300f1e152.gif[/img]


Mirthwood aims to give you a blank canvas, along with the tools and assets to build an aesthetically pleasing and productive farm. We’re excited to see your designs come to life!

notes.title: Questing in Mirthwood - Unveiling the Adventure
notes.content:
Hey Everyone, Daron here from Bad Ridge Games.

Curious about your adventures in Mirthwood? Whether it’s meeting new people, building up your character, or unraveling rich storylines; there is much to do and experience beyond your farm. In this post, we’ll explore what questing looks like in Mirthwood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/fc07d06925efd3dd3d2ca7c096953cab79859b7a.png[/img]

[h2]Exploration[/h2]

To start, it’s important to understand a bit about the game world. Mirthwood thrives on exploration. Our central thesis has been to merge the cozy comforts (and challenges) of home-building with the freedom and adventure of open world discovery. Hand-crafting a diverse, dangerous, and rewarding map has been a major point of focus for us.

Comprised of six main regions and many sub-biomes, the world of Mirthwood stretches from deep woods to desolate wasteland, from dark barrows to frigid mountain foothills. Unique locations dot the landscape, offering opportunities to uncover stories, find rare loot, and fight for survival.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/03e29a712d0a90ad661f1516a3ad7697b4ab6d42.png[/img]

[h2]Questing[/h2]

[h3]Main Storyline[/h3]
Mirthwood will feature a central storyline for you to unravel at your own pace. Having fled a war-torn homeland, you arrive on the shores of the Free Lands, ready to rebuild your life from the ground up. You will begin to uncover the secrets of this new land - and critically - understand the reality of its past…and your future.

[h3]Side Quests[/h3]
You will also find many side quests to collect (or ignore). These range from emotional matters of heart, to quirky adventures, to the mundane medieval favor. Some quests are shaped by the tangible needs and desires of the game’s characters. Contracts play a big part here, allowing you to hunt down some of Mirthwood’s fabled foes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/feea7eb96ea9a29627f4af8682c94370bf0c4aaa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/2f3981ac765f0013c922b506fa8f07531da5f1ee.png[/img]

[h2]A Dynamic World[/h2]
No world stays the same forever. Key to Mirthwood’s design is the principle of change. Here, seasons will pass, the economy will shift, and NPCs you know, [i]your friends[/i], will die. While Mirthwood has its share of crafted stories, we also want you (and the world) to generate your own, with the hope that no two playthroughs are alike. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/3b46179573b3d97e7100cb8cc906f79ab0e18a8f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/aa0b716a743dcbdd26c9e0764c00ef8923e2bb80.png[/img]

Here are some of the things we’re working on, and what you should expect as you quest and explore in Mirthwood:
[list]
[*] [i][b]The Toils of Medieval Life[/b][/i]
NPCs are at the mercy of the world, just as you are. Disease, poverty, and other dangers are at the doorstep.
[*] [i][b]Choice & Consequence[/b][/i]
Some scenarios will present you with choices of permanent significance. This can involve the life and death of characters, effects on the landscape, and more.
[*] [i][b]Dynamic Events[/b][/i]
Events like dust storms, blizzards, or attacks on towns can be generated by the game’s storyteller. These present hardships to navigate as you play.
[*] [i][b]Clues[/b][/i]
Occasionally, you will stumble across clues leading you to environmental stories, maps, or other encounters generated as a response to actions in the world.
[*] [i][b]Morality and Renown[/b][/i]
The choices you make will affect how others perceive you. Your Morality and Renown will be weighed and measured. Who will you choose to be?
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/4ec624ff41511c5ad8203b1028f33a13eec47dad.png[/img]

We want everything you do to be worth your time. For us, that means generating meaningful stories and encounters, finding fun and epic loot, and customizing and leveling your character as you see fit. And let’s not forget about the homestead altogether. We want to give you a chance to impact the world and the characters you meet, not as a savior - but on your terms.

We hope this gives you a little more insight into what questing in Mirthwood will look like. Let us know your thoughts and feedback fellow adventurers!

notes.title: Introducing Mirthwood
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, adventurers![/h1] We're glad you stopped by, we can't wait to share more about this world with you.

This post will serve as a brief introduction to who we are, and more importantly, what Mirthwood is all about. We'll also touch on what you can expect in the coming weeks and months. We're eager to have you embark on this journey with us, so - let's jump in!

[h1]What is Mirthwood?[/h1]
At its heart, Mirthwood is an immersive medieval fantasy world that allows you to choose who you want to be. It’s a game where your choices matter, where the world around you is alive and may come for you - and your neighbors.

The idea for Mirthwood was born from a shared love of fantasy, adventure, and the simple joy of cultivating your own little corner of the world. We wanted to create a game that blended the tranquil satisfaction of farming with the thrill of combat, role-playing, and the exploration of a large, diverse open world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/963c3ebe5dbb349802d03e29ed31565b4f0f249e.jpg[/img][i]Traveling an ancient forest path[/i]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
In Mirthwood, you’ll manage your own homestead, with the freedom to cultivate a wide variety of crops, orchards, and livestock. You'll also have more freedom of expression than most games, as we won't confine your creativity into grids. 

You will encounter a diverse range of foes as you branch out, take on quests, and explore the open world. Surviving enemies and the elements will require strategy and skill. Your character will be a reflection of your choices, beginning with the custom character creator, and continuing with the specializations and skills you will unlock over time. These are influenced by your actions in the game.

Mirthwood is set in a richly detailed, dynamic world, ripe for exploration. From serene farmlands to dark, mysterious forests, each environment is unique and filled with secrets to discover. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/6406cb4b79ec85701f037b92f9f6ce22393649ea.jpg[/img][i]A calm night at the Hazy Hag Tavern, the bard plays a lively tune[/i]

The characters in Mirthwood are as diverse as the world itself. You'll meet friendly townsfolk, eccentric hermits, and perhaps a few unsavory personalities. Each one plays a part in the larger story of Mirthwood.

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
This has been a [i]very[/i] brief glance at Mirthwood. We'll be diving deeper into the mechanics, characters, and world of Mirthwood in future blog posts. Expect in-depth looks at our farming system, DNA system, combat and RPG mechanics, character profiles, and updates on our development progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43906942/590709d21bde8161895a2ad59717d8606c9f7952.jpg[/img][i]Spending the day at home[/i]

[h1]About the Devs[/h1]
We're a two-man team located up in the Pacific Northwest, USA. Our backgrounds are primarily in the game and film industries, with gaming being a shared passion of ours.

We've got a few other contributors from around the US helping us with a number of tasks, including crafting a high-quality original soundtrack. Our friends at [url=https://www.vicariouspr.com/?ref=blog.badridgegames.com]V Publishing[/url] are helping us bring Mirthwood to a screen near you.
